titleEn: Bathtub or Shower for Your Vancouver Bathroom Renovation? A 2026 Cost and Lifestyle Guide
titleZh: 溫哥華浴室翻新：浴缸還是淋浴？2026造價與生活實用指南
contentEn:
Choosing between a new bathtub and a walk-in shower is one of the first decisions Vancouver homeowners face in any bathroom renovation. The answer depends on three factors: who uses the bathroom, what you spent on the renovation, and how long you plan to stay in your home. Reno Stars has completed over 200 bathroom renovations across Metro Vancouver since 2018. Here is what the real cost and lifestyle data shows.

How Much Does a Bathtub Cost in Vancouver 2026

A standard alcove bathtub installed by a licensed plumber costs $800 to $3,500 for the unit itself in the Vancouver market. Installation — including plumbing connections, waterproofing, tile work, and labour — adds $7,000 to $15,000, putting a complete tub renovation at $8,000 to $25,000. A walk-in bathtub, designed for seniors or people with mobility challenges, runs $5,000 to $12,000 for the unit and $8,000 to $18,000 installed. Walk-in tubs require a dedicated 15-20 amp electrical circuit, which some older Vancouver homes built before 1980 may not have pre-wired.

How Much Does a Walk-In Shower Cost in Vancouver 2026

A curbless walk-in shower built from scratch — including demolition, subfloor preparation, waterproofing, tile or shower-pan installation, and labour — ranges $10,000 to $28,000 in Metro Vancouver. At the higher end, a spa-style curbless shower with large-format porcelain tiles, a frameless glass enclosure, and a rain-head system can reach $35,000 to $45,000. Extras that add cost: relocating the drain ($1,500 to $3,500), raising the floor to accommodate a zero-threshold entry ($2,000 to $5,000), or upgrading plumbing fixtures ($800 to $3,000 per trim kit).

Bathtub and Shower Combination: The Premium Option

Some Vancouver homeowners choose both: a walk-in tub plus a separate walk-in shower in one bathroom. This is the most expensive route, with costs ranging $20,000 to $45,000 depending on bathroom size and fixture selection. Reno Stars installed a combined walk-in tub and curbless shower for a client in North Vancouver in 2024, with the full project — demolition, structural reinforcement for the floor, plumbing upgrades, curbless shower, walk-in tub, and custom tile work — coming to $38,000. It required a dedicated 60-litre water heater to support back-to-back use, which added $1,800 to the project.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

What Vancouver Bylaws and Building Code Say

Any bathroom renovation involving plumbing in Vancouver requires a City of Vancouver building permit. This includes moving or adding drains, altering the wet area waterproofing, or changing a bathtub location. The BC Building Code 2024 specifies minimum drain sizes (50mm for showers vs 40mm for bathtubs) and mandates pressure-balancing valves to prevent scalding on all new tub and shower installations. In stratas, the strata council must approve any changes to the wet area before a city permit is applied for.

What Vancouver Homeowners Actually Chose in 2024–2025

Of 27 bathroom renovation projects Reno Stars completed in 2024, 18 specified a walk-in shower as the primary bathing fixture and 6 retained a standard alcove tub. Three clients installed a combined tub-shower configuration. Of the clients who chose walk-in showers, the most common reason given was accessibility: either the client themselves or a parent visiting regularly was over 65. Three clients cited resale value, noting that a modern curbless shower appeals to a broad buyer range.

BC Government Rebates for Accessible Bathroom Upgrades

As of 2026, the BC Medical Equipment and Supplies rebate and the Home Accessibility Tax Credit can offset up to $17,000 of the cost of a walk-in tub or curbless shower installation for qualifying seniors or people with disabilities. Reno Stars has experience preparing the documentation required to apply for these credits, including Occupational Therapist letters and contractor quotes in the format required by Service Canada.

Which Is Right for Your Vancouver Home?

A bathtub is the right choice if you have young children (regular baths are part of the routine), you are on a tighter renovation budget, or your strata does not permit shower pan modifications. A walk-in shower is the better long-term investment for aging-in-place, resale value, and modern design. If your bathroom is large enough and your budget allows, the combined configuration gives maximum flexibility. Reno Stars offers a free on-site consultation at your Vancouver home, including a written scope and fixed-price quote.

  • Standard Bathroom Renovation with Shower Conversion in Coquitlam
  • Two Bathroom Renovation with Custom Features in Burnaby

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is a walk-in shower more expensive than a bathtub in Vancouver?

Yes. A standard alcove tub installed costs $8,000 to $25,000 in Metro Vancouver. A comparable walk-in curbless shower costs $10,000 to $28,000. The premium for a walk-in shower reflects additional waterproofing, floor preparation, and larger tile areas.

Can I replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower without a permit in Vancouver?

No. Any work that alters the wet area, moves drains, or modifies waterproofing requires a City of Vancouver building permit. A qualified contractor pulls the permit; Reno Stars handles this as part of the project scope.

What is the BC government rebate for walk-in bathtubs in 2026?

The combined BC Medical Equipment rebate and federal Home Accessibility Tax Credit can cover up to $17,000 of qualifying costs for walk-in tubs or curbless showers installed for seniors or people with disabilities. A doctor's note and contractor documentation are required.

Does keeping a bathtub increase Vancouver home resale value?

In strata buildings, some bylaws require at least one bathtub in each unit. In detached homes, the impact depends on buyer demographics. Reno Stars' project data shows curbless showers appeal broadly to buyers aged 35 to 60, but families with young children may still expect a bathtub.

How long does a walk-in shower renovation take in Vancouver?

A standard walk-in shower conversion takes 12 to 18 working days from demolition to handover, including the mandatory City of Vancouver inspection. A full bathroom gut renovation with curbless shower and custom tile typically runs 3 to 5 weeks.

在溫哥華浴室翻新工程中，選擇浴缸還是步入式淋浴是業主面對的首要決定之一。答案取決於三個因素：誰使用浴室、翻新預算多少、以及計劃在房屋居住多久。聚星裝修自2018年以來已在卑詩省大溫地區完成超過200個浴室翻新項目。以下是實際造價和生活需求的數據分析。

溫哥華浴缸翻新2026年費用

溫哥華市場上，由持牌水管工安裝的標準嵌入式浴缸，連工包料造價由$8,000至$25,000加元。另有為長者或行動不便人士設計的步入式浴缸，連安裝費用由$13,000至$30,000加元。步入式浴缸需要獨立15至20安培電路，部分1980年前建造的溫哥華舊屋可能未預設此線路。

溫哥華步入式淋浴翻新2026年費用

無障礙步入式淋浴的新建工程，包括清拆、地基處理、防水工程、瓷磚鋪設及人工，造價由$10,000至$28,000加元。頂級配置包括大規格瓷磚、無框玻璃圍欄及雨淋式花灑系統，費用可達$35,000至$45,000加元。排水管移位費用另加$1,500至$3,500；墊高地面以實現零門檻入口費用另加$2,000至$5,000。

浴缸加淋浴組合：頂級方案

部分溫哥華業主選擇兩者兼備：於同一浴室設置步入式浴缸及獨立淋浴間。這是最昂貴的方案，費用由$20,000至$45,000加元，視乎浴室面積及設備選擇。聚星裝修2024年於北溫哥華為一位客戶安裝了組合方案，整個項目造價$38,000加元。項目需增設60公升熱水缸以支援接連使用，額外費用$1,800加元。

計劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修取得免費無義務報價。

溫哥華建築條例及卑詩省建築規範

溫哥華市內任何涉及水管工程的浴室翻新均須申請市府建築許可證，包括移動或增加排水管、改動防水範圍或更改浴缸位置。2024年卑詩省建築規範規定淋浴排水管最小口徑為50毫米，浴缸為40毫米，並要求所有新裝浴缸及淋浴設備必須安裝壓力平衡閥以防燙傷。在分契物業，翻新前須先獲分契管理委員會批准。

2024至2025年溫哥華業主的實際選擇

聚星裝修2024年完成的27個浴室翻新項目中，18個以步入式淋浴為主要沐浴設備，6個保留標準嵌入式浴缸，3個採用浴缸加淋浴組合。選擇步入式淋浴的客戶，最常見原因是無障礙需求（業主本人或經常探訪的65歲以上長者）。另有3位客戶提及轉售價值，認為現代無障礙淋浴設計對買家具廣泛吸引力。

卑詩省政府無障礙浴室翻新補貼

截至2026年，符合資格的長者或殘疾人士，可透過卑詩省醫療設備補貼及聯邦家居無障礙稅收抵免，報銷高達$17,000加元的步入式浴缸或無障礙淋浴安裝費用。聚星裝修有經驗為客戶準備申請所需文件，包括職業治療師證明信及符合Service Canada要求的工程報價單。

如有幼童、日常需要洗澡、預算有限、或分契條例不允許改動淋浴排水口，浴缸是正確選擇。步入式淋浴在長期居住、無障礙aging-in-place）及轉售價值方面是更佳投資。如浴室空間和預算允許，組合方案提供最大彈性。聚星裝修提供免費上門諮詢，包括書面工程範圍及固定價格報價。

常見問題

溫哥華步入式淋浴是否比浴缸更昂貴？

是的。溫哥華標準嵌入式浴缸連安裝造價$8,000至$25,000加元。同等配置的無障礙淋浴造價$10,000至$28,000加元。差價反映額外防水工程、地面處理及更大面積瓷磚鋪設。

在溫哥華我可以不申請許可證將浴缸改為淋浴嗎？

不可以。任何改動濕區、移動排水管或修改防水層的工程均須申請溫哥華市建築許可證。聚星裝修會代為申請許可證。

2026年卑詩省政府對步入式浴缸有何補貼？

卑詩省醫療設備補貼及聯邦家居無障礙稅收抵免合計可報銷高達$17,000加元符合資格的費用。申請需要醫生證明信及工程文件。

保留浴缸會否增加溫哥華房屋轉售價值？

在分契大廈，部分條例要求每個單位至少設有一個浴缸。在獨立屋，影響視乎買家群體。聚星裝修項目數據顯示，無障礙淋浴對35至60歲買家具廣泛吸引力，但有幼童的家庭可能仍期望有浴缸。

溫哥華無障礙淋浴翻新需要多長時間？

標準無障礙淋浴改建由清拆至交付需12至18個工作天，包括溫哥華市強制驗收。全屋浴室清拆翻新並鋪設無障礙瓷磚通常需3至5週。
